patterns: APPSC asks current-affairs one-liners: DefExpo 2020 venue (Lucknow), DefExpo 2022 theme 'Path to Pride' (Gandhinagar).
The one APPSC iDEX item is a 'NOT correct' statement set: iDEX targets the defence and aerospace ecosystem, is funded/managed by DIO, a not-for-profit company (formed by HAL and BEL).
Likely traps: DIO founders (HAL + BEL, not DRDO), FDI caps (26% in 2001 vs 74% automatic now), DPP 2016 IDDM vs 2017 SP model vs DAP 2020 offsets.
App is far more detailed than PYQs (2026 data, VIMARSH, RAKSHA, DPM 2025); fine for current-affairs prep but APPSC asks simpler event/venue/agency facts.
AP tilt: Visakhapatnam (Eastern Fleet, NSTL), BEL Palasamudram and Machilipatnam are plausible APPSC targets.
